title: Data-Driven Modeling of Molten Chloride Corrosion Using Static Test Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.07125v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Molten chloride corrosion has been studied for decades, yet reliable prediction across different alloys, salts, and test conditions remains difficult. In this work, 291 static molten chloride corrosion experiments reported in the literature were compiled into a structured dataset and used to develop an interpretable machine-learning framework for corrosion-rate predictions. To better represent the differences in salt condition across studies, a Chloride Salt Preparation Index (CSPI) was introduced to bring the reported salt-treatment method, atmosphere control, and pre-exposure impurity condition on a common numerical scale. A blended tree-based ensemble provided the most consistent predictive performance, achieving a cross-validated \(R^2\) of 0.85 and an MAE of 0.41 mg cm\(^{-2}\) day\(^{-1}\). The graded CSPI retained more useful information than a simple purified/unpurified classification and emerged as the dominant model descriptor.

translated_title: 基于静态试验数据的熔融氯化物腐蚀数据驱动建模
translated_abstract: 熔融氯化物腐蚀已被研究数十年，然而在不同合金、盐类和试验条件下实现可靠预测仍存在困难。在这项工作中，研究者将文献中报道的291个静态熔融氯化物腐蚀实验汇编成一个结构化数据集，并据此开发了一个用于腐蚀速率预测的可解释机器学习框架。为了更好地表征不同研究之间盐条件的差异，该工作引入了氯化盐制备指数（CSPI），将文献中报道的盐处理方法、气氛控制和预暴露杂质状态统一到同一数值尺度上。一种混合树模型集成方法提供了最稳定的预测性能，交叉验证R²达到0.85，平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.41 mg cm⁻² day⁻¹。分级形式的CSPI比简单的纯化/未纯化二分类保留了更多有用信息，并成为模型中的主导描述符。
tldr: 该研究汇编291个静态熔融氯化物腐蚀实验数据，创新性地提出氯化盐制备指数（CSPI）来量化盐条件差异，构建可解释机器学习框架实现了高精度的腐蚀速率预测（交叉验证R²达0.85）。
en_tdlr: This study compiled 291 static molten chloride corrosion experiments into a structured dataset, introduced a novel Chloride Salt Preparation Index (CSPI) to quantify salt-condition differences, and developed an interpretable machine-learning framework achieving accurate corrosion-rate prediction (cross-validated R² of 0.85).
